title: The Roanoke Fortress
summary: After a grueling two-hour diversion up two-lane U.S. Route 11, the critical care ambulance and the three-car Rubber Duck convoy arrive at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke, where Zoë's six older siblings—including her eldest sister Megan—and Ben Carter are already waiting to reinforce the family fortress. With the hospital strictly enforcing a one-person overnight visitor limit, Lauren takes the Sunday night pre-op watch as cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Hassan briefs Jordan on his 6:00 AM open-heart bypass surgery (CABG), Zoë confirms her romantic feelings on a late-night video call, and the entire family gathers before dawn to see Jordan into the operating room and endure the ten-hour wait.
